keys.rcout_axis_note: RCOUT axes are derived from the shared ArduSub vectored-6DOF servo map. vertical_mean/sum compare signed vertical motor output; yaw_diff_proxy compares horizontal differential output.

velocity_gyro_score_no_depth.definition: Depth-excluded score over DVL xyz and IMU gyro xyz. Lower normalized_rmse is better; higher mean_correlation is better.

operational_confidence_no_depth.definition: Controller-development confidence. DVL xyz and yaw-rate combine phase, RMS amplitude, and bounded RMSE; roll/pitch rates are evaluated mainly as a stability envelope. This is not a system-identification grade truth score.
